law: A change is landed when main contains it AND the landing-tier receipt is green at that exact tip. Installs, snapshots and physical acceptance are separate concerns and never gate a landing. Every gate here is derived from a GitHub Actions workflow, with provenance recorded: CI and local run the same commands, so a green landing receipt means no CI surprise in the covered surface.

tiers.landing: Run and pass at the exact tip before pushing toward main. Serialised, minutes, no runner-only infrastructure. The pre-push guard enforces a green receipt for HEAD.
tiers.walks: Long acceptance walks and wide browser batteries. Required when the change touches shell, walks or multi-surface behaviour; the walk receipts are committed evidence.
tiers.ci-only: Requires GitHub runners, pinned owner checkouts, multi-target builds or live services. Not locally executable: listed so a landing receipt honestly names what it deferred to CI.
